shortDescription: Module to manage datacenter quotas in oVirt/RHV

options.name: auth
options.description: Dictionary with values needed to create HTTP/HTTPS connection to oVirt:

options.name: cluster_grace
options.description: Cluster grace(hard limit) defined in percentage (1-100).

options.name: cluster_threshold
options.description: Cluster threshold(soft limit) defined in percentage (0-100).

options.name: clusters
options.description: List of dictionary of cluster limits, which is valid to specific cluster. If cluster isn't specified it's valid to all clusters in system:

options.name: data_center
options.description: Name of the datacenter where quota should be managed.

options.name: description
options.description: Description of the quota to manage.

options.name: fetch_nested
options.description: If I(True) the module will fetch additional data from the API. It will fetch IDs of the VMs disks, snapshots, etc. User can configure to fetch other attributes of the nested entities by specifying C(nested_attributes).

options.name: id
options.description: ID of the quota to manage.

options.name: name
options.description: Name of the quota to manage.

options.name: nested_attributes
options.description: Specifies list of the attributes which should be fetched from the API. This parameter apply only when C(fetch_nested) is I(true).

options.name: poll_interval
options.description: Number of the seconds the module waits until another poll request on entity status is sent.

options.name: storage_grace
options.description: Storage grace(hard limit) defined in percentage (1-100).

options.name: storage_threshold
options.description: Storage threshold(soft limit) defined in percentage (0-100).

options.name: storages
options.description: List of dictionary of storage limits, which is valid to specific storage. If storage isn't specified it's valid to all storages in system:

options.name: timeout
options.description: The amount of time in seconds the module should wait for the instance to get into desired state.

options.name: wait
options.description: C(yes) if the module should wait for the entity to get into desired state.
